Amy — thanks for the invite and the SIG fragment. A few concrete items to move this forward: 

1) SSO: We'll send SP metadata by EOD Feb 21. Attribute map request: please map 'email' -> user.mail and 'role' -> https://schemas.redwoodinference.com/claims/role. We prefer IdP-initiated SSO for the vendor portal.

2) Escrow & key custody: Redwood's standard practice is customer-managed KMS/HSM for customer keys. For the encrypted-blob escrow option we use a sealed-blob protocol: the blob is encrypted with a Redwood KMS key that is itself stored in a restricted HSM. Access requires two approvals and an auditable ticket in our change control system.

I'm attaching a short redacted excerpt of our dual-control procedure (3 paragraphs) for portal consumption. Note: we cannot share private key material via the portal — we will provide the custody procedure and associated logs/evidence. If BlueHelix requires a recoverable private-key escrow, we recommend coordinating an on-site key ceremony or using a third-party key escrow CA.

3) Evidence: to satisfy the SIG questions you listed we'll upload the following artifacts to OneTrust: KMS/HSM architecture diagram (redacted), rotation policy excerpt, sample audit log (redacted), and the dual-control excerpt. We will not upload any actual private keys.

4) Next steps: Monica, can you please create a HubSpot deal note (BL-98234) and schedule a 30-min call Feb 23 to finalize the procurement checklist?

Amy — happy to jump on the call the 23rd. If you need anything sooner, call me.

Thanks,
